# `retention.set`

Set a retention policy value.

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `reversible`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice retention-set`
- **MCP tool:** `retention_set` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `policy_name` | `str` | required |  |
| `days` | `int` | required |  |

## Examples

```
operator-voice retention-set --policy-name default --days 10
```
